name: @frejsi/shared
description: Contracts and domain logic shared by web and poller. No framework imports.

scripts.prisma:check: prisma validate && prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema-datamodel prisma/foundation.prisma --script | diff - prisma/migrations/0001_foundation/migration.sql && prisma migrate diff --from-schema-datamodel prisma/foundation.prisma --to-schema-datamodel prisma/food.prisma --script | diff - prisma/migrations/0002_food/migration.sql && prisma migrate diff --from-schema-datamodel prisma/food.prisma --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --script | diff - prisma/migrations/0003_ai/migration.sql
